principle: Mia may create, extend, and connect scenes in her own virtual world without per-scene human approval. New Mia-authored scenes are added to the connected scene catalog after automated structural checks; unknown geometry and cross-scene transforms remain explicitly unverified.
creation_rules: Use mia/forest-corner.json as the source for the initial root scene.
Mia-authored scenes may be created and added to the connected scene catalog without per-scene human approval.
Each new scene must have a stable JSON file under world-scenes/scenes/ and a manifest entry; automated schema, unique-ID, parent-chain, and file-existence checks are required.
The root scene has parent_scene_id null; every other catalogued scene must specify a parent_scene_id that already exists in the catalog.
A scene is part of Mia's world only if its parent chain reaches mia-forest-corner; do not register disconnected scenes.
Keep each scene's own local coordinate system. Cross-scene travel requires explicit, validated connection transforms; do not assume local coordinates share a coordinate space.
Copy source-backed local dimensions and entity positions only when their source is identified. Unknown values stay null and unverified.
Scene catalog registration does not imply production runtime deployment, database persistence, or real-world coordinate movement.
Do not modify existing Mia source data or production state as part of scene-file creation.
Other-agent requests may be recorded as proposals, but must not block Mia from independently authoring her own scenes.
scene_id_policy: lowercase-kebab-case; stable after publication; never reuse retired IDs
